caveat: When configured and initialized as per Section 3.1 of the Security Policy and when operated in FIPS mode with tamper evident labels installed as indicated in Appendix A. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: The Brocade 7840 Extension Switch provides fast, reliable WN/MAN connectivity for remote data replication, backup, and migration with Fibre Channel and advanced Fibre Channel over IP (FCIP) technology.
